tests.name: native::sharing_tests::entry_line_lookup_preserves_typed_stop_causes
tests.scope: Actual prepare fixture; entry_candidate called while admission inputs remain active and snapshot control is cancelled/expired, forcing error from line lookup after valid source-range mapping. Both indexed-cache and cleared-cache mode retain exact ToolkitError code and exit. Public symbol entry separately preserves the same cause. Also cancel deterministically at second controlled fallback scan poll using actual OperationControl.
tests.limitation: Public-entry check uses already-stopped control; internal mapping regression is separately caught by typed entry_candidate result. No claim of a mid-query public-thread race test.

resourcePolicy.meaning: Conservative internal ceiling for an optional line-offset cache, not a new business admission limit, RSS measurement, or measured necessary allocation. Existing source input/file admission and operation control still apply. Worker process memory enforcement is unchanged; this cache ceiling is not claimed derived from a worker RSS allotment. Actual offset Vec capacity is accumulated with checked subtraction; map metadata remains bounded by admitted file count. Cap or allocation failure falls back to cancellation-polled prefix scanning and does not reject admitted input. Fallback costs must be included in any later performance measurement.
